description: Pre-distribution gate. Reads brain/brand-amplification/campaigns/social-channel-directory.md (the Global Channel Value Directory) and BLOCKs distribution to any BANNED subreddit, community, or group. WARNs on Low ROI channels. Instance-portable via CAREER_HOME env var.
litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file — exit 0=no banned channels, exit 1=BLOCK (banned channel targeted), exit 2=WARN (low ROI or missing dir).

files.HOW.py: Enforcement gate — check all campaign spokes against channel directory
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance audit — detect past banned-channel distribution attempts
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — signal stale_templates if block rate exceeds 20%

origin_incident: 2026-04-23: r/ClaudeAI and r/LocalLLaMA were included in campaign spokes despite being banned. Gate built to prevent distribution to banned channels.
_product_vs_solution_marker: product-vs-solution: example — origin docs / authorship attribution
